dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Good evening. What's your address, please?
dialogue.reading: ɡʊd ˈiːvnɪŋ. ˈwʌts jʊr ˈædrɛs, ˈpliːz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈtwɛnti ˈfaɪv ˈrɑːmə ˈfɔːr ˈroʊd, ˈbɑːŋ ˈrɑːk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: ˈrɑːmə ˈfɔːr ˈroʊd. ˈɑːr ˈeɪ ˈɛm ˈeɪ, ˈrɑːmə.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thank you. Is Bang Rak the district?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː. ɪz ˈbɑːŋ ˈrɑːk ðə ˈdɪstrɪkt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. And the zip code is 10500.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ənd ðə ˈzɪp ˌkoʊd ɪz ˈwʌn ˈzɪroʊ ˈfaɪv ˈzɪroʊ ˈzɪroʊ.
